_comment: FBC 13 roster, seeded from the existing Excel handicap workbook on May 18, 2026. Each member needs EITHER a 'ghin' field (for automated daily updates) OR a 'manual_handicap' block (for non-GHIN players). The seeded values from Excel are used until you add GHIN numbers — at which point the daily workflow takes over and live GHIN data overrides the seeded HI and low_hi. The historical fields (draft_hi, fbc12_index, played_fbc12) are static and always sourced from this file.
